scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @kervan/server" "npm run dev -w @kervan/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kervan/client && npm run build -w @kervan/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
